mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_consume_log ( event_id, consumer_group, topic, message_key, status, first_seen_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{consumerGroup}, #{topic}, #{messageKey}, 'PROCESSING', NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN status ELSE 'PROCESSING' END, topic = VALUES(topic), message_key = VALUES(message_key), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE event_consume_log SET status = 'SUCCESS', processed_at = #{processedAt}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND consumer_group = #{consumerGroup}
UPDATE event_consume_log SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND consumer_group = #{consumerGroup} AND status <> 'SUCCESS'
